lines.en: Walking in snow leaves my toes cold.

lines.zh: 我小跑着跟在篷车后面。
lines.en: I trot along behind the caravan.
The snow is deep, so I hop instead.

lines.zh: 我踩出一串很小的脚印。
lines.en: I leave a line of very small footprints.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我的羽毛就乱了。
lines.en: One gust and my feathers fall out of order.
I follow the wheel ruts to save effort.

lines.zh: 篷车压过的雪硬，我踩着走。
lines.en: The snow the wagon packed is hard; I walk on top of it.
I go around the snowdrift ahead.
When the wheels stop, I stop too.
My steps are as light as falling snow.
I squeeze toward the warmth of the cart.

lines.zh: 这一路，我都在队伍最后。
lines.en: All this way, I walk at the back.
The snow is too bright to look at.
Every two steps, I shake my feathers.
I follow the wheel ruts.

lines.zh: 雪面的壳托住我，咔一声
lines.en: The crust of the snow holds me, then cracks.
I perch on the shaft and preen.
Too cold, so I tuck my head in.
No clouds, but the wind is fierce.

lines.zh: 我在听雪落下来的声音。
lines.en: I listen to the sound of snow landing.

lines.zh: 篷车里有人在小声说话。
lines.en: Someone in the cart is speaking softly.
I tilt my head and watch a flake melt.
I call once; nobody answers.
I scrape my claws on the cart boards.

lines.zh: 飞起来太费力气，先歇着。
lines.en: Flying takes effort; I will rest first.

lines.zh: 这一片白，我看了好多天。
lines.en: I have watched this white land for days.
Something warm is moving near me.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，像块灰石头。
lines.en: I tuck into a ball like a gray stone.
Everyone in the caravan knows me.

lines.zh: 我在等他们收拾好上路。
lines.en: I wait for them to pack and move.

lines.zh: 我抬头看篷车的顶，风在响
lines.en: I look up at the wagon roof; the wind is loud.
I tuck my tail feathers and crouch.

lines.zh: 我从篷车里飞出来鸣叫。
lines.en: I fly out of the wagon and call.
Did you come by caravan too?
I tilt my head at you; my neck is fine.

lines.zh: 你的帽子看起来很好住。
lines.en: Your hat looks like a fine place to nest.
I know the cart; I do not know you.
Do not reach out; I will fly first.

lines.zh: 你走得近，我的羽毛竖了。
lines.en: You come closer and my feathers rise.

lines.zh: 你会带我去更暖的地方吗？
lines.en: Will you take me somewhere warmer?
Did you hear the call I made?
I am small, but I can call loudly.
Let me stand in the snow by your feet.

lines.zh: 我在你肩上待一会行吗？
lines.en: May I sit on your shoulder awhile?
Ow! Something struck my wing.
My feathers are scattered on the ground.

lines.zh: 雪灌进翅膀，我飞不起来。
lines.en: Snow is packed into my wings; I cannot fly.
I cannot fly; my legs are shaking.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我打进了雪里。
lines.en: That blow knocked me into the snow.
Even my call has changed pitch.
I shiver underneath the cart.
The wing is bent; at least I can walk.

lines.zh: 雪从我的翅膀上被抖下来。
lines.en: Snow shakes loose from my wings.

lines.zh: 我张嘴想叫，只吐出几根绒。
lines.en: I open my beak to screech but only spit out bits of down.
What is that? It smells like seeds.
Something in your hand is rattling.
I hop one step closer, then half back.
Give me one seed and I will sing.
That is worth landing for.
Do not pinch it; I cannot peck it free.
I fly up, then settle back down.

lines.zh: 味道很香，我胆子变大了。
lines.en: It smells good, so my courage grows.
Crouch a little and I can reach it.
Is my calling too loud for you?
One seed is enough; I am not greedy.
I circle your hand, watching closely.
If you move, I will hop backward.
After this seed, I will follow you.

lines.zh: 那东西在手心里滚了一下
lines.en: That thing rolled once in your palm.
I land on your shoulder to take a look.
I bumped you and lost a feather.

lines.zh: 我扑棱着飞起来，撞歪了毛。
lines.en: I flapped up and knocked a feather crooked.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的护腿，翻了个跟头。
lines.en: I hit your greaves and tumble head over heels.
I brushed right past your face.

lines.zh: 对不起，我落地没看地方。
lines.en: Sorry, I landed without looking.
Your sleeve knocked me off balance.

lines.zh: 我再飞高一点，就不撞了。
lines.en: I will fly higher and stop bumping you.
I hide under the cart for some quiet.
One bump will not shake me apart.
Stand still; I am landing on your shoulder.
My call is meant to find a mate.
There is another one on the cart.

lines.zh: 我们对着叫，就算说好了。
lines.en: We call to each other and that is agreement.
I must preen my feathers first.
In cold weather, two of us share warmth.

lines.zh: 你也听见那声回应了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear the answer to my call?

lines.zh: 我们绕着车顶飞了两圈。
lines.en: We flew two circles over the cart.
Its tail feathers are longer than mine.

lines.zh: 春天到了，我们才谈这个。
lines.en: We only discuss this once spring arrives.
This small body of mine is enough.
I grab with my claws and miss.
Can I carry off this shiny thing?
I carry it into the cart to hide.

lines.zh: 我拖不动，就在雪里埋起来。
lines.en: I can't drag it, so I bury it in the snow.
You dropped it, and I saw.
Hide it well; do not let the driver see.
My beak is too short, so I roll it along.
A brass button; I'll carry it off to line my nest.
Holding it in my beak, I cannot call.
Drop it in the snow and it is lost.
Something is moving under the snow.
I spot a small shadow.
That is not one of my flock.
Something is approaching the cart.
I raise my crest and call first.
There is a rustle over there.
My wings open without my asking.
Who touched our cart?
I fly higher to see farther.
The ground is trembling slightly.
I call first, then decide whether to fly.
It has not noticed me yet.
I lower myself flat against the snow.
This angle is right for a dive.
Its eyes are turning this way.
One call, then I dive.
The wind is at my back; perfect.
One more step is close enough.

lines.zh: 爪子收进绒毛里，看不出来。
lines.en: Claws tucked in the fluff, out of sight.
If it turns, I take off.
I dive and peck exactly once.
My strength is small, but my aim is true.
It retreated half a step from my peck.
I fly up and circle behind it.
That strike left my wings sore.
Do not underestimate this little snow bird.
I dive screaming; it is quite frightening.
After the peck I flee, very quickly.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在它背上留了痕。
lines.en: My claws left a mark on its back.
Does this count as fighting? I think so.

lines.zh: 我从篷车的毯子里钻出来。
lines.en: I crawl out from the caravan blankets.
On landing, I call once.
This is not snow; it is too warm.
The egg opens and I shake my feathers.
I am looking for that cart.

lines.zh: 陌生的地方，我先飞一圈。
lines.en: Strange place; I will fly one circle first.
There are no wheel ruts on the ground.

lines.zh: 我的叫声在空地上很响。
lines.en: My call rings loudly in the open.
Who brought me to this place?
First steady myself, then preen.

lines.zh: 火苗一舔，我的羽毛焦了。
lines.en: One lick of flame and my feathers singe.

lines.zh: 从篷车顶滑落，翅膀没兜住风。
lines.en: I slip off the wagon roof; my wings catch no air.

lines.zh: 雪化的水灌进绒里，我直往下沉。
lines.en: Meltwater soaks my down and I sink straight down.

lines.zh: 一声巨响，我被气浪掀飞。
lines.en: A blast threw me clear off my feet.
Something grazed the tip of my wing.

lines.zh: 光一照，我羽毛都立起来了。
lines.en: The light made every feather stand up.

lines.zh: 饿得我叫不动，也飞不动。
lines.en: Too hungry to call or fly.

lines.zh: 雷声太近，我羽毛都麻了。
lines.en: The thunder was so close my feathers went numb.

lines.zh: 往下掉，风把我的叫声吹散。
lines.en: Falling, the wind tears my call apart.
